title: Raisukaree
method: Chop onions, peppers, mangetout, and chicken.
Fry curry paste with minced garlic on high heat for 2 minutes.
Add chicken, reduce heat, and cook through.
Pour in coconut milk, soy sauce, and half the lime juice; simmer 5 minutes.
Add mangetout and peppers 5 minutes before serving.
Garnish with lime wedges and coriander.
